clue: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?
The more of this you take, the more you leave behind. What is it?
What has keys, but no locks; space, but no room; and you can enter, but never go inside?
What can travel around the world while staying in a single corner?
What has a head and a tail that will never meet, and has no body?
I am tall when I am young, and I am short when I am old. What am I?
What has a neck but no head, and wears a cap?
What belongs to you, but everyone else uses it more than you do?
What gets wetter and wetter the more it dries?
What can you catch, but never throw?
What runs around the whole yard without moving an inch?
What has many rings but no fingers?
What building has the most stories?
What goes up but never comes down?
If you have me, you want to share me. If you share me, you haven't got me. What am I?
What has hands, but cannot clap?
What has to be broken before you can use it?
I have branches, but no fruit, trunk or leaves. What am I?
What has many teeth, but cannot bite?
What begins with T, finishes with T, and has T in it?
What is full of holes but still holds water?
What question can you never answer yes to?
What can you break, even if you never pick it up or touch it?
I shave every day, but my beard stays the same. What am I?
What has a thumb and four fingers, but is not a hand?
Where does today come before yesterday?
What kind of room has no doors or windows?
Forward I am heavy, but backward I am not. What am I?
What has one eye, but cannot see at all?
The person who makes it has no need of it; the person who buys it has no use for it. The person who uses it can neither see nor feel it. What is it?
